title: Pre-match cards (3 modes)
one_line: QUICK MATCH, VS COMPUTER and PASS & PLAY on one hero-popup chassis: what you are playing with, what it costs, what you win.
also_read: UI_BIBLE/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 8.1 - the per-card content table is there.

files.test_menu: Ludo NX/UI/Screen Test/Match Setup - Quick Match | Vs Computer | Pass and Play

gaps: The Quick Match card is titled ONLINE. Project law: rename to QUICK MATCH.
VS COMPUTER captions ('TAP TO EDIT', 'Costs 1 energy') are about 7 pt. Minimum is 12.
Corners use the old isometric dice stamps. The match flow gets house-colour Lucky Six corners (bible 3).
No section labels between the groups, so the card reads as one undifferentiated block.

shared_chassis.card: Hero NX Card, 380 wide, cream rim 10, Lucky Six corners in the HOUSE COLOURS board-ordered (bible 3).
shared_chassis.top: The person's avatar (Quick Match) or the mascot (Vs Computer, Pass and Play) straddling the TOP EDGE, with the nameplate just inside (bible 4.3).
shared_chassis.sections: Section labels (bible 5.5) between every group - Lilita 14 CAPS ink.muted with a hairline each side.
shared_chassis.action: PLAY - play red slab, XL, straddling the bottom edge in a 6 pt cream collar, with the multiplier coin on its top-right (bible 5.19).
shared_chassis.close: 44 cream disc X, 24 pt below the card. No back button - this is a popup (bible 5.9).
shared_chassis.scroll: Max height = screen - top inset - 120. The CONTENT scrolls, not the card.

variants.title: QUICK MATCH
variants.top: The player's avatar straddling the top edge.
content: YOUR SET - two wells (dice, token), each opening the matching shop tab
EMOJIS - 4 x 2 wells, tap to edit the loadout
STAKE - multiplier chips (bible 5.19): unselected neutral, selected option, locked disabled with the unlock hint under it
WIN / LOSE line - 'Win +120 NX / Lose -60 NX' in ink.win and ink.lose
variants.forbidden: The word ONLINE. No claim that a real player will be found.

variants.title: VS COMPUTER
content: YOUR HOUSE - four house discs, the chosen one ringed
OPPONENTS - one seat row per bot: name, and a difficulty chip Easy / Normal / Hard
Every bot seat is labelled BOT

variants.title: PASS & PLAY
content: Seat rows - house disc plus an editable name field (bible 5.25)
variants.omit: No stake chips, no multiplier coin, no energy line, no NX.

states: Out of energy - PLAY goes disabled and the energy line becomes a tappable link to the energy popup.
Locked multiplier - disabled chip with the unlock rule under it ('Reach 800 max energy'). Never just faded.
Nothing equipped - YOUR SET wells show the default set, not empty holes.
Pass and Play with a blank name - the seat falls back to 'Player 2', it never blocks PLAY.
motion: Open and close: tokens.json motion.popupOpen / popupClose.
PLAY breathes - the only idle on the card.
data: Equipped dice and token, emote loadout: local today, server-owned once the shop is real.
do_not: Do not use the word ONLINE.
Do not let any caption fall below 12 pt.
Do not use the isometric dice corner stamps - house-colour Lucky Six corners only.
Do not show a stake, a multiplier or an energy cost on Pass and Play.
Do not give the popup a back button, and do not let the card itself scroll.
Do not build three separate prefabs. One chassis, three variants, one builder.
acceptance: All three variants come off one chassis with house-colour Lucky Six corners.
Every caption is 12 pt or larger - check the VS COMPUTER card specifically.
No screen element says ONLINE; every bot seat says BOT.
Pass and Play shows no stake, no multiplier and no energy.
Out of energy disables PLAY and the energy line opens the energy popup.
A locked multiplier chip is in the disabled kind with its unlock rule visible.
Bible section 11 in full, per variant.
steps: 2. Build the shared hero chassis: card, house-colour corners, top-edge avatar/mascot, nameplate, collar PLAY, close X.
3. Rename ONLINE to QUICK MATCH across the modal, the carousel and any analytics label.
4. Build the three variants' content as sections with section labels between them.
5. Fix every caption to at least 12 pt.
6. Wire YOUR SET wells to the shop tabs, the emoji grid to the loadout editor, the chips to MultiplierService.
7. Handle out-of-energy, locked chips, nothing-equipped and blank-name states.
8. Capture all three variants plus out-of-energy. Postflight.
prompt:
Rebuild the three Ludo NX pre-match cards on one hero-popup chassis.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 6.8, 4.3 and 3, UI_BIBLE/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 8.1, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

The bones are already right - avatar on the top edge, loadout, emoji grid, big PLAY with the multiplier coin. Four things change:

1. The Quick Match card is titled ONLINE. Rename it QUICK MATCH everywhere. Project law: never label a mode online and never claim a real player was found, until online play actually ships.
2. The VS COMPUTER captions are about 7 pt. Nothing a player must read goes below 12 pt.
3. The corners use the old isometric dice stamps. The match flow gets Lucky Six notched corners in the HOUSE COLOURS, board-ordered: top-left red, top-right green, bottom-left blue, bottom-right yellow.
4. Add section labels between the groups so the card reads as YOUR SET / EMOJIS / STAKE rather than one block.

Build ONE chassis with three variants (see the 'variants' array), not three prefabs. Pass & Play shows no stake, no multiplier and no energy - it is free and it must look free. Every bot seat on VS COMPUTER carries a BOT tag.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list, with a capture of each variant.
